company.name: Seqoon
company.shortDescription: A service for finding and purchasing shares in a second home. Seqoon makes co-ownership of vacation homes accessible and effortless.

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables individuals to purchase fractional shares of vacation homes through an LLC structure, providing property ownership and scheduled use at a portion of the full purchase cost.
productsAndServices.name: Fractional Vacation Home Co-Ownership

productsAndServices.description: An online marketplace for browsing and purchasing shares in selected vacation homes, with property details, locations, layouts, sizes, share prices, and availability status.
productsAndServices.name: Vacation Home Listings Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A property management service covering the ongoing operation and upkeep of co-owned vacation homes, including furnishings, utilities, maintenance, and coordination with co-owners.
productsAndServices.name: Vacation Property Management

productsAndServices.description: A website and app-based system that lets co-owners view availability, schedule allocated nights, book stays up to 24 months ahead, and obtain additional days from other owners.
productsAndServices.name: Owner Stay Booking and Scheduling Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that helps property owners sell a portion of an existing vacation home while retaining a remaining share, and supports co-owners in re-listing or selling their ownership shares.
productsAndServices.name: Co-Ownership Share Resale and Property Liquidity Service
